name: Scraps
unlock_text: You are a stall on the mid decks with a bench, a crate and a handful of coins. Rent is due. Every scrap is a decision.
notes: Rent 5 a day. A few buyers, small bank, small mistakes.

name: Trade
unlock_text: The first machines hum. Regulars know your face. Something bigger than a stall has started to notice you.
notes: Rent 50. Vents and digesters keep the loop closed; mail begins to matter.

name: Workshop
unlock_text: You build things that other stalls buy to fix their own. The ring starts to send mail.
notes: Rent 500. Precision work and licensed goods.

name: Concern
unlock_text: The company now writes to you by name. You are part of the supply: if you fail, the station notices.
notes: Rent 5000. The tithe grows with the concern.
